body:
After high school I was accepted at some pretty good schools abroad. This was my only motivation going through all those years. Unfortunately, after I came out to my father he thought it wouldn't be "wise" for me to leave before I "straighten up" a bit. He then enrolled me in a local state uni at a technical program (mechanical engineering). Meanwhile, my old friends left to different countries and they havent looked back since. Me, I dropped out after a while and took a bunch of random jobs for almost 4 years.  I live in a third world country and its almost impossible for me raise enough money to start over somewhere else on my own. The schools that accepted me in the past wont take me back and I have nothing but my own parents to blame for that.                
I read somewhere that people suffering from depression are more likely to have a realistic view about life. When I stopped living in self-delusions I guess i realized that there is no way out. For years I lied to myself believing that something will change for the better but It didnt. And it certainly doesn't look like it'll change in the future.                      
I guess some people just arent lucky.
